In addition to the inherent complexity of this task, focusing on medical text generation necessitates the analysis and proposal of additional chest-RRG-oriented metrics based on NLP models. Exploring novel methods to assess the reference report against an estimated one can facilitate a more comprehensive evaluation of state-of-the-art models.
